usageNotes: Use this endpoint to enumerate all notification targets configured on the cluster before creating or updating a notification matcher or routing rule. The caller must hold at least one of Mapping.Modify, Mapping.Audit, or Mapping.Use on /mapping/notifications. Results include both built-in targets (e.g., the default sendmail target) and user-created ones; check the 'origin' and 'disable' fields to avoid referencing a disabled or unmodifiable built-in.

examples.summary: List all notification targets to find available sendmail and webhook endpoints

tips: origin='builtin' targets cannot be deleted; origin='modified-builtin' means a built-in was customized by the user.
A target with disable=true will silently drop notifications — filter these out before assigning to a matcher.
The 'name' field uses pve-configid format (alphanumeric + hyphens, no spaces), which is required when referencing targets in notification matchers.
